newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0805 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Up 0.100 to off 0.100 cent. Possible carryover from 10-month high Friday but cash beef market weak and live seen topping soon.
FEEDER CATTLE - Steady to up 0.200 cent. Index up and lower corn futures seen on expected large corn crop.
LEAN HOGS - Steady to up 0.150 cent. Steady to higher live calls on continued tight hog supplies and higher pork product.
PORK BELLIES - Off 0.200 to up 0.100 cent. Reports of product moving into storage but hog slaughter remains light.
